title: Define persona, skill catalog, and prompt composition boundaries
description: AstrBot has dedicated PersonaManager and SkillManager surfaces that feed main-agent prompt composition. Rust should avoid embedding persona resolution, skill activation, and prompt rendering directly into ProcessStage or plugin SDK code when main-agent parity starts.

files.change: Resolve default/session persona and folder metadata outside the agent runner.
Separate skill discovery/activation from plugin handler registration.
Keep prompt composition policy testable before agent request decoration is implemented.

criteria: ProcessStage does not own persona or skill prompt policy.
Persona selection and skill activation have typed ports that can later back dashboard APIs.
Agent runner request decoration consumes resolved persona/skill data through explicit inputs.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test --workspace
